indexes.//: The check-in list: everyone who has arrived but has no bracelet yet, in name order. Firestore supports equality against null, so this is the query behind the 'Who is this?' screen.
Prefix search on the check-in list, for when the roster outgrows loading it whole. See docs/firestore-schema.md, 'Search'.
End-of-night reconciliation across every participant's ledger: all transactions in a time window, newest first. Collection-group scope because transactions are nested per participant.
Per-terminal cash-up: what did this device take tonight.
Per-staff-member cash-up, for the same reason.
